For a fixed tree, indicator Y_v of a surviving vertex with no surviving neighbors satisfies E[Y_v]=p q^{d_v}; for nonadjacent distinct u,v, E[Y_u Y_v]=p² q^{d_u+d_v−1_{dist=2}}; adjacent pairs cannot both be isolates. Thus Var(I_T)=mu-mu²+2p²F_T(q). Identical degree multisets force the same mu, so variance ordering is exactly the sign of the polynomial F_T−F_H. Inspected explicit complete certificate and finite exhaustive algorithm: 1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47 unlabelled tree types for n=2..9; degree-matched pairs 0,0,0,0,1,5,23,96 and reversal pairs 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,3, with one identical-variance pair at n=9. Independently generated the unlabeled tree families and exact integer F-polynomials with SymPy rational Sturm interval root counts, confirming all counts and the witness F_T−F_H=−q(1−q)^2(2q²+2q−1). The resulting variance difference −2p^4(1−p)(2p²−6p+3) switches precisely at p=(3−sqrt(3))/2; independent 512-survival-state enumeration for the witness checks rational p=1/2 and 4/5. This is an exhaustive finite cutoff through 9, NOT a claim for all larger trees.
